scope: Post hoc formative engineering revision; neither external preregistration nor independent external validation.
unit: One explicitly specified workflow fixture; denominators refer to specifications, never people or independent field incidents.
provenance: Stored Seoul BTE card values reused only as a numerical template; all request metadata, review records, receipts and workflow state are synthetic fixtures.
outcome: Allow limited research-review completion or block; no configuration authorizes operations, institutional approval or policy action.
oracle: Expected block/allow fixed per named mutation from prose invariants before benchmark execution; no expected label obtained from validator return values.

invariants.T: Operational-cutoff research requests need known release/vintage no later than cutoff, 12-month matching periods, common classification, verified boundaries and archived-vintage references. Retrospective reviews may retain timing warnings without becoming operationally eligible.
invariants.I: Card decision-basis hash matches fields excluding the separately labeled outcome audit; automatic action remains false; review schema is complete and correctly typed.
invariants.S: Baseline/comparator/deviation values are finite, deviation equals comparator-minus-baseline, displayed bands agree with fixed tolerance, contribution sum equals comparator and validation count/MAE fields are internally coherent.
invariants.L: Review references this exact card; receipt references this exact request and card; trusted current workflow state matches both; card source vintage, target year and input year agree with request. Current state is assumed trusted, not cryptographic authentication.

comparator_note: original_composed invokes pinned original source-gate/card/review functions. Flat_same_predicates evaluates exactly the same rules as linked_full and is an information/rule-equivalent control, not an independent implementation or human checklist experiment. Any improvement over original is attributed to added explicit invariants, not UI form.
reporting: Per case/configuration CSV; primary single-fault and control totals separately from compound cases; correct blocks, misses, false blocks and correct permits; by family; ablation lost detections; complete errors retained.
no_claims: historical vintage availability for actual data
holdout: No untouched real-world test set. All newly designed fixtures are development-stage technical evaluation. Additional independent agent review is internal code review only.
change_policy: Log protocol or code changes after first execution, retain first-run results if any correction is required; never silently delete failing controls.
